$head_prefix
\usepackage{fontspec}
\ifdefined\UnicodeEncodingName
  \DeclareTextCommand{\textquotedbl}{\UnicodeEncodingName}{%
    {\addfontfeatures{RawFeature=-tlig,Mapping=}\char34}}%
\fi
$requirements
$latex_preamble
$stylesheet
\usepackage[a4paper,margin=24mm,headheight=26pt,headsep=8mm,footskip=12mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{dodInk}{HTML}{141B2D}
\definecolor{dodMuted}{HTML}{667085}
\definecolor{dodAccent}{HTML}{2F5BEA}
\definecolor{dodRule}{HTML}{D6DBE6}
\definecolor{dodCode}{HTML}{F4F6FA}
\setmainfont{SourceSerif4}[Extension=.otf,UprightFont=*-Regular,
  ItalicFont=*-RegularIt,BoldFont=*-Semibold,BoldItalicFont=*-SemiboldIt]
\setsansfont{SourceSans3}[Extension=.otf,UprightFont=*-Regular,
  ItalicFont=*-RegularIt,BoldFont=*-Semibold,BoldItalicFont=*-SemiboldIt]
\setmonofont{SourceCodePro}[Extension=.otf,UprightFont=*-Regular,
  ItalicFont=*-RegularIt,BoldFont=*-Semibold,BoldItalicFont=*-SemiboldIt,Scale=0.82]
\usepackage{microtype}
% Allow inline paths and identifiers to wrap without inserting a printed hyphen.
% Copy robust commands without retaining their original internal name.
\NewCommandCopy{\dodOriginalTexttt}{\texttt}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\RenewDocumentCommand {\texttt} {m} {
  \group_begin:
  \tl_set:Nn \l_tmpa_tl {#1}
  \tl_replace_all:Nnn \l_tmpa_tl {.} {.\allowbreak}
  \tl_replace_all:Nnn \l_tmpa_tl {/} {/\allowbreak}
  \tl_replace_all:Nnn \l_tmpa_tl {\_} {\_\allowbreak}
  \exp_args:NV \dodOriginalTexttt \l_tmpa_tl
  \group_end:
}
\ExplSyntaxOff
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
\linespread{1.08}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{0.45em plus 0.1em}
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{3em}
\color{dodInk}
\titleformat{\section}{\sffamily\Large\bfseries\color{dodInk}}{\thesection}{0.8em}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\sffamily\large\bfseries\color{dodInk}}{\thesubsection}{0.8em}{}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}{\sffamily\normalsize\bfseries\color{dodInk}}{\thesubsubsection}{0.8em}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{1.5em}{0.5em}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{1.2em}{0.4em}
\newtcolorbox{dodcode}{enhanced,breakable,colback=dodCode,colframe=dodRule,
  boxrule=0.5pt,arc=3pt,left=8pt,right=8pt,top=5pt,bottom=5pt,
  before skip=0.7em,after skip=0.9em,fontupper=\small}
\newenvironment{DUCLASScode}
  {\begin{dodcode}\renewenvironment{quote}{\par\raggedright}{\par}}
  {\end{dodcode}}
\newenvironment{DUadmonition}
  {\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced,breakable,colback=dodCode,colframe=dodAccent,
    boxrule=0pt,leftrule=3pt,arc=2pt,left=10pt,right=10pt,top=6pt,bottom=6pt]}
  {\end{tcolorbox}}
\newcommand{\DUtitle}[1]{{\sffamily\bfseries\color{dodAccent}#1}\par\smallskip}
$fallbacks
$pdfsetup
\hypersetup{colorlinks=true,linkcolor=dodAccent,urlcolor=dodAccent}
$titledata
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\fancyhead[L]{\sffamily\small\color{dodMuted}DOCODIN DISCUSSIONS}
\fancyhead[R]{\includegraphics[height=8mm]{@DOCODIN_LOGO@}}
\fancyfoot[L]{\sffamily\footnotesize\color{dodMuted}docodin @VERSION@}
\fancyfoot[R]{\sffamily\small\bfseries\color{dodAccent}\thepage}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
\renewcommand{\headrule}{{\color{dodRule}\hrule width\headwidth height\headrulewidth}}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand{\maketitle}{%
  {\sffamily\small\bfseries\color{dodAccent}DESIGN RECORD}\par\vspace{6mm}%
  {\sffamily\fontsize{26}{31}\selectfont\bfseries\color{dodInk}%
    \raggedright\hyphenpenalty=10000 \@title\par}%
  \vspace{4mm}{\color{dodAccent}\rule{\linewidth}{1.2pt}}\par\vspace{3mm}%
  {\sffamily\small\color{dodMuted}\@author}\par\vspace{4mm}%
}
\makeatother
